ImageDescription.value: Locator map of Wanju County in Jeollabuk-do (now Jeonbuk State), South Korea. Wanju County is highlighted in pale yellow; the red marker indicates the Wanju County Office. The map reflects the administrative boundaries shown in the February 2013 revision and predates the Jeonju–Wanju boundary adjustment that took effect on 8 December 2013.
